verdict.rationale: Installed plugins let ChatGPT/Codex work directly on the user's connected data and return AI-generated outputs. Documented examples include summarizing Slack channels and drafting replies, working across Drive/Docs/Sheets/Slides, scanning code to confirm vulnerability findings, and Notion research and knowledge capture. A community user also describes a Metabase skill for querying analytics data. missing for 10: explicit documentation of proactive insight/suggestion generation (e.g., dashboards or recommendations) beyond task-level summaries, and independent hands-on corroboration of insight quality on user data.
